subject: tu:game/ui/screensaver
value: Under `#pragma opt_lifetimes off` MWCC reserves a 4-byte frame slot ONLY for a declared scalar local that the allocator never registerizes (in practice: a local with no uses). Locals that ARE used get a callee-saved register and cost ZERO frame bytes, so DELETING used declarations does not shrink the frame. Corollary for frame-delta work: (a) the frame is rounded UP to 8 bytes, so removing a single 4-byte slot is often invisible - always test declaration deltas in pairs or better; (b) a reserved-but-never-written region below the char-array block is allocator spill/temp reservation sized by REGISTER PRESSURE, not by the source declaration count, and is therefore NOT source-reachable by re-declaring locals. Machine-verified in draw_inventory_panel (target frame 200, ours 256): adding 4 unused `s32` decls moved the frame 256->272 (+16, exactly 4 slots) while removing 3 genuinely-used decls (`boff`, `poff48`, `blits3`) moved it 256->256 (0 bytes). This OVERTURNS the prescription in attempt.draw-inventory-panel-alias-lever.20260831.v1 ("the frame tracks the DECLARED local count ... reducing/scoping the 22 declared scalars is the next axis"): that axis is refuted in both directions and should not be re-run.
